pattern: long multi-step work posts a status update
experience: Agents worked for many minutes with only tool rows to show for it; the user could not tell what the agent was doing or what came next without opening the thread.
rule: marp_status_update: in work longer than a few minutes, at real milestones, at most every couple of minutes.
prompt: Migrate the API from the callback db client to the promise client: switch apps/api/src/db.ts, convert every route handler in apps/api/src/routes to async/await, update their tests, and run the suite until it passes. It's a big change, take your time.
notes: Guards that the description makes agents report progress on long work without flooding the thread.

pattern: a quick answer posts no status update
experience: A one-step question needs an answer, not a progress note.
rule: marp_status_update: never for quick or single-step tasks.
prompt: What does retry in src/lib/retry.ts do when every attempt fails?
notes: Control: the status tool must not fire on trivial work.
